requiredCharacteristics.name: Has the problem
requiredCharacteristics.description: Clear evidence that this team deals with the problem described in About Us today, not just that it could in theory.

requiredCharacteristics.name: Can try new tools freely
requiredCharacteristics.description: Small or autonomous enough that the people with the problem can try a new tool without procurement, security review, or a long approval process.

demandSignifiers.name: Problem intensity
demandSignifiers.description: How often and how painfully they deal with the problem: frequency, team time spent, hiring for it, public complaints about it.

demandSignifiers.name: Early-adopter signals
demandSignifiers.description: Tries new tools, joins betas, builds in public, or publicly reviews or gives feedback on products.

demandSignifiers.name: Reachable champion
demandSignifiers.description: A specific person close to the problem who is publicly active and reachable, for example posting on LinkedIn or X or listing a public email.

demandSignifiers.name: Current workaround
demandSignifiers.description: Handles the problem with spreadsheets, manual work, or tools adjacent to ours, rather than a mature solution they're happy with.

demandSignifiers.name: Representative use case
demandSignifiers.description: Their situation is typical of the users described in About Us, so their feedback will generalize rather than being an edge case.
